events.title: Meltopia DEMO is live
events.summary: Hello everyone! We're happy to announce that the Meltopia demo is now available to everyone!Meltopia is our minimalist game where you'll venture into a snowy world full of mysteries and glacial secrets. Explore its vastness by melting the snow, collecting valuable resources and ancient artifacts.Go to the main Steam page and play for free right now.Join our Discord to discuss the game, report bugs, or make suggestions for improvement. We look forward to seeing you all!

events.title: Big Event in Silicone Heart
events.summary: Hey everyone! We have great news: we're launching a Kickstarter campaign for our best game — Silicone Heart together with publisher Crytivo. For the announcement, we've prepared a new trailer featuring real gameplay, atmosphere, new locations, and key mechanics.
